191418646.reason: Left-edge branch for x<=-2 tests y in range(-x, abs(x)), which is empty, so points on the left edge (e.g. (-97,0)) match no branch and nothing is printed; expected 387.

193191838.reason: Quadrant classifier never assigns the bottom-edge segment (quad 4) and defaults to the left-edge formula, so (-7,-13) on the bottom edge yields 27 instead of 52.

200117074.reason: Left-edge condition uses the constant y>=4 instead of y>=x (typo), so (-1,-1) falls through to the else branch and prints 0 instead of 3.

206358102.reason: In quadrant IV it returns 4*|y|+1 for points with x<|y|+1, but the bottom edge segment is reached on turn 4*|y|: (37,-100) prints 401 instead of 400.

211700308.reason: Assigns the diagonal x==y<0 (bottom-left corner) to the bottom edge, printing -4y, but that corner ends the left-edge segment reached on turn 4|x|-1: (-1,-1) prints 4 instead of 3.
